articles.summary: Amelia Childress has joined Increase to help with strategic, compliance, and regulatory matters. She spent a decade leading compliance for Square, Cash App, and Block.
articles.title: Welcoming Amelia Childress to Increase — Increase

articles.summary: Some early PayPal folks gave me advice that went against all my instincts as an engineer: When you’re starting out building a payments product, don’t build any customized tools to prevent fraud. Instead, have a human review every transaction. Do this until you’re seeing thousands of payments per day.
articles.title: Start simple with fraud controls — Increase
